panic.name: Panic Table
panic.description: Roll 1d6 + Stress. Results of 7-15 trigger panic effects.

results.text: Nervous Twitch: Gain +1 Stress. All allies in Short range gain +1 Stress as your tension spikes the squad.
Tremble: Until end of scene: -2 dice to all AGI-based rolls (Marksmanship, Mobility, Stealth).
Fumble/Jam: GM chooses one: drop held item; weapon jams (1 Fast action to clear); comms/camera/evidence mishandled (next related roll -2 dice).
Freeze: Lose your next action (combat: lose next turn). You may defend normally but cannot Push again until after you act.
Seek Cover: Use next action moving to cover/safer position if possible. If you refuse, take +1 Stress at start of each round until you comply.
Outburst on Camera: You shout/scream/swear. Lose next action; position revealed (enemies +2 dice to locate/target). If witnesses/Third Eye present, GM introduces 'bad footage' complication.
Flight Response: Must retreat from threat for at least 1 full round or one zone away. During this cannot take Slow actions.
Operative Breakdown: Choose: BERSERK (attack nearest creature next action, friend/foe) OR CATATONIC (incapacitated D6 rounds). Allies who witness gain +1 Stress.
Mind Fracture: Immediately suffer a Mental Critical Injury (roll Mental Critical Table) and apply it now.

physicalCritical.name: Physical Critical Injuries (D66)
physicalCritical.description: Roll 2d6 - first die is tens, second is ones (shown as tens.ones)

results.name: Winded
results.effects: Lose next Fast action; -1 die to physical rolls for 1 round.

results.name: Rattled
results.effects: -1 die to Marksmanship and Observation for 1 scene.

results.name: Sprained wrist
results.effects: -2 dice to actions using that hand (shooting, melee, crafting).

results.name: Sprained ankle
results.effects: Movement is a Slow action until treated.

results.name: Scalp cut
results.effects: Bleeding: take 1 damage per round until Healing roll succeeds (Slow action).

results.name: Concussion
results.effects: -2 dice to WIT-based rolls for D6 shifts.

results.name: Cracked ribs
results.effects: -2 dice to Mobility; Running costs +1 Stress.

results.name: Dislocated shoulder
results.effects: Arm unusable for melee/shooting; can still hold light items.

results.name: Broken fingers
results.effects: Reloading requires both actions (Fast+Slow); -2 dice to fine tasks.

results.name: Broken nose
results.effects: -2 dice to Persuasion; blood/mask issues impose -1 die on Observation.

results.name: Deep thigh gash
results.effects: Movement becomes Slow; if you Run, take 1 damage after the move.

results.name: Hearing loss
results.effects: -2 dice to Observation checks relying on sound/comms cues.

results.name: Knocked-out teeth
results.effects: -2 dice to Persuasion; intimidation attempts +1 die if you show the injury.

results.name: Crushed toes
results.effects: Movement Slow; -2 dice to Mobility in cluttered zones.

results.name: Gouged eye
results.effects: -2 dice to Marksmanship and Observation (depth perception).

results.name: Busted kneecap
results.effects: Cannot Run; Movement Slow.

results.name: Broken arm
results.effects: Arm unusable; no 2-handed weapons.

results.name: Broken leg
results.effects: Movement Slow; Retreat requires Mobility roll or fall prone.

results.name: Punctured lung
results.effects: -2 dice to Stamina & Mobility; each round you exert yourself take 1 damage.

results.name: Bleeding gut
results.effects: Each Slow action costs 1 damage (internal bleed).

results.name: Ruptured intestines
results.effects: Infection risk: each day roll Stamina; fail = take 1 damage.

results.name: Severed arm artery
results.effects: Arm unusable; must be stabilized or death check at time limit.

results.name: Severed leg artery
results.effects: Movement impossible unaided; must be stabilized.

results.name: Cracked spine
results.effects: Collapse prone; cannot Move without help; if not stabilized becomes permanent paralysis.

results.name: Ruptured jugular
results.effects: Immediate stabilize or die at time limit.

results.name: Ruptured aorta
results.effects: Immediate stabilize or die at time limit.

results.name: Severed arm
results.effects: Permanent loss; immediate +2 Stress from shock.

results.name: Severed leg
results.effects: Permanent loss; you collapse; movement impossible unaided.

results.name: Impaled heart
results.effects: You are Broken; only stabilization prevents death.

results.name: Crushed skull
results.effects: You die immediately.

results.name: Disembowelled
results.effects: You die immediately.

results.name: Pierced head
results.effects: You die immediately.

results.name: Spinal sever
results.effects: You die immediately (or GM option: permanent paralysis if cinematic).

results.name: Massive trauma
results.effects: You die immediately.

results.name: Total organ failure
results.effects: You die immediately.

results.name: Catastrophic destruction
results.effects: You die immediately.

mentalCritical.name: Mental Critical Injuries (D66)
mentalCritical.description: Roll 2d6 - first die is tens, second is ones (shown as tens.ones)

results.name: Shaken
results.effects: +1 Stress; -1 die to all rolls for 1 round.

results.name: Tunnel vision
results.effects: -2 dice to Observation; you miss side details.

results.name: Jumpy
results.effects: Must spend Fast action to Focus before any ranged attack or power use.

results.name: Intrusive media loop
results.effects: -2 dice to Insight/Persuasion (can't read people; hear 'commentary').

results.name: Nausea
results.effects: First Slow action each scene costs +1 Stress.

results.name: Dissociation
results.effects: Cannot Push social rolls; speech becomes flat/odd (roleplay flag).

results.name: Anxiety spiral
results.effects: +1 Stress each shift until safe rest stretch.

results.name: Nightmares
results.effects: Sleep doesn't clear Stress unless you succeed Insight roll per sleep shift.

results.name: Phobia (triggered)
results.effects: Near trigger: +1 Stress per round; cannot Push.

results.name: Compulsion: Check kit
results.effects: Start of each scene: spend 1 Fast action checking kit or take +1 Stress.

results.name: Paranoia (no help)
results.effects: Cannot receive Help dice; reject assistance unless persuaded.

results.name: Emotional shutdown
results.effects: -2 dice to EMP rolls; can't connect or comfort.

results.name: Rage trigger
results.effects: When harmed/insulted: pass Resolve check or retaliate next action.

results.name: Guilty fixation
results.effects: -2 dice to WIT rolls unless pursuing obsession in scene.

results.name: Hallucinations (voices)
results.effects: Each shift: roll Insight; fail = lose next action to arguing/listening.

results.name: Flashbacks
results.effects: Blood/dim light: +1 Stress per round; cannot Push.

results.name: Fugue risk
results.effects: When Stress ≥5: once per scene GM may remove 1 action (lose time).

results.name: Self-medication
results.effects: If don't take coping substance daily, start next session at +2 Stress.

results.name: Major breakdown
results.effects: Broken for D6 rounds; afterward -2 dice to mental rolls for 1 day.

results.name: Catatonia
results.effects: Unresponsive for D6 rounds (combat) or 1 stretch (non-combat).

results.name: Violent derealization
results.effects: In darkness allies count as 'unknown shapes': -2 dice to avoid friendly fire.

results.name: Panic flight
results.effects: If threatened: must Retreat unless pass Resolve; cannot hold position.

results.name: Ebb echo (if Ebon)
results.effects: Whenever you Push gain +1 extra Stress (so Push = +2 Stress total).

results.name: Camera-worthy mania
results.effects: -2 dice to Stealth; if don't do something bold each scene +1 Stress.

results.name: Permanent phobia
results.effects: As Phobia but only therapy/arc resolution removes it.

results.name: Permanent paranoia
results.effects: Cannot accept Help dice without therapy/arc resolution.

results.name: Identity fracture
results.effects: Define new persona/compulsion; -1 die to EMP until resolved in play.

results.name: Amnesia (episodic)
results.effects: Lose last shift of memory; GM introduces concrete complication/lead loss.

results.name: Total amnesia
results.effects: Forget squad and role; must be managed in play.

results.name: Psychotic break
results.effects: Broken now; on recovery gain lasting delusion/compulsion.

results.name: Heart seizure
results.effects: Each shift make Stamina; fail = death.

results.name: Suicide impulse
results.effects: If left alone attempt self-harm; allies can restrain/persuade/treat.

results.name: Total collapse
results.effects: Stress cannot be relieved naturally; if Stress ≥7 at day end, die of shock.

results.name: Vegetative state
results.effects: Unresponsive; only advanced care prevents permanent loss.

results.name: Fatal panic
results.effects: Unless stabilized medically, you die.

results.name: Heart stops
results.effects: You die immediately.

rangedCriticalFail.name: Ranged Weapon Critical Fail (2-12)
rangedCriticalFail.description: Trigger on pushed attack with stress bane and zero total successes.

results.text: Awkward stance: You overextend. Suffer -1 die to your next ranged attack this scene.
Exposed: You lean too far from cover or step into the open. Enemies gain +1 die to attack you until the start of your next turn.
Fumbled reload: You mis-seat a magazine or drop a round. No damage, but you lose your next Fast action (or must spend a Fast action immediately) to fix it.
Slipped aim: Your shot goes wild. The GM may move your attack to a different target or object in the same zone.
Spent mag: You miscounted your rounds. After resolving the miss, your magazine is empty; set ammo to 0 for that magazine.
Jammed: The weapon jams hard. You cannot fire it again until you spend a Slow action to clear the jam.
Weapon dropped: Recoil or surprise makes you lose your grip. You drop the weapon in your zone; picking it up costs a Fast action.
Harsh recoil: You wrench your arm or shoulder. Take 1 damage ignoring armor and -1 die to all ranged attacks until you receive first aid or rest a stretch.
Collateral damage: Your stray fire hits something important. The GM creates an immediate new hazard that threatens you or your squad.
Catastrophic jam / partial break: A casing ruptures, or internal parts shear. Take 1 damage ignoring armor, and the weapon is broken until repaired.
Overload / explosion: The weapon catastrophically fails. Take 2 damage ignoring armor and suffer an automatic Physical Critical Injury roll. The weapon is destroyed.

meleeCriticalFail.name: Melee Weapon Critical Fail (2-12)
meleeCriticalFail.description: Trigger on pushed attack with stress bane and zero total successes.

results.text: Off balance: You over-swing. Suffer -1 die to your next Melee attack this scene.
Overextended: You stumble into a bad position. Enemies attacking you in Engaged range gain +1 die until the start of your next turn.
Slip or trip: You lose footing. You fall prone or stagger; standing costs a Fast action.
Minor strain: You tweak a wrist, elbow, or ankle. Take 1 damage ignoring armor but no other effect.
Friendly tangle: You clash with an ally’s position. One nearby ally suffers -1 die to their next action this round.
Weapon stuck / over-committed: Weapon user: weapon sticks; spend a Fast action to free it. Unarmed: cannot Parry until your next turn.
Weapon dropped / grip broken: Weapon user: drop weapon; pick up costs Fast action. Unarmed: suffer -2 dice to Melee until end of scene or treated.
Self-inflicted knock: You strike a solid surface. Take 1 damage ignoring armor and lose one Fast action on your next turn.
Bad landing / joint damage: Take 2 damage ignoring armor and suffer -2 dice to physical rolls involving that limb until healed.
Weapon break / serious strain: Weapon: damaged (-2 dice) until repaired; if already damaged, it breaks. Unarmed: take 2 damage ignoring armor and -2 dice to Melee until medical treatment.
Catastrophic self-harm: Take weapon’s base damage (or 2 unarmed) ignoring armor and immediately roll a Physical Critical Injury.
